segments.title: Opening News Desk: Young Thug Trial & Live Show Announcement
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens late Friday broadcast; announces live comedy show next Wednesday 7:30 PM Pacific with Tim; Kendelle making Grinch ornaments in studio; Young Thug trial discussion begins.

segments.title: Young Thug Trial Coverage Setup
segments.notes: Case searches for Young Thug trial clips; mentions bleach reference; Jeff Ripple joins; sub goal reached — messy wings eating pending.

segments.title: Hype Train Interruption (Level 6)
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers broadcast for 10 minutes during sub hype train; Quad City DJs Christmas songs; thanks subscribers including Skull Meat, Skimer, Metal Chaos, Giggle Trash, Dilemma, Tam Tran, Daddy Kev.

segments.title: Young Thug Trial Deep Dive with Jeff Ripple
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple returns; watches Twitter clips of trial — anime Bleach analogy used by defendant, DA burden-shifting objection sustained, prosecutor questioned on criminalizing speech; 17 lyric sets admitted as evidence; RICO implications for Trump Fulton County case discussed; slime/Nickelodeon Gack tangent.

segments.title: Transition to Therapy & Manga Talk
segments.notes: Case thanks Jeff; mentions AI military use; Case reads One Piece chapter 1100; Shonen Jump subscription; transitions to Therapy segment.

segments.title: Therapy Session with Dr. Chath
segments.notes: Dr. Chath session: Harvey Dent/Two-Face, Harvey from Sabrina, Mormonism, lethal company loop, Cool Runnings as Christmas movie, Bleach as Christmas movie, bathroom windows, John Candy assassination, Kendelle (girlfriend) appears, GYAT slang, Mariah Carey Christmas song, card king 10 community sub gifts.

segments.title: Munch & Crum Debate: 'Young' in Rap Names After Age 40
segments.notes: Debate topic from Psychor: should rappers with 'Young' in name legally change it when old (Young Bucks pushing 40)? Munch claims ancient Sumeria immortality; Crum argues cultural naming conventions; Carl Jung dragged in; Crum gains score lead; Munch forced to kneel/apologize after death remark; audience applause rhythm noted.

segments.title: Post-Debate & Rob Elvie Check-In
segments.notes: Case checks on Rob Elvie per chat demand; Rob appears, claims fictional country Alvalstonia; Case bans Rob from studio; Rob's voice distorts into Rick (Amongst the Web host); Rob leaves threatening return.

segments.title: Trailer Time: Fast and Feel Love with Trent
segments.notes: Trent at movies with Chris (parole officer/legal guardian); watches 'Fast and Feel Love' trailer (Thai Fast & Furious parody with whiplash-style drumming); audio issues; Case rushing to see Wish movie.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid to Dink Sauce
segments.notes: Trent signs off, raids Dink Sauce (chicken shit bingo in Unreal Engine); Case mentions Tuesday stream; waiters/haters joke.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchored a chaotic late Friday broadcast featuring Young Thug trial coverage with Jeff Ripple, a Level 6 Hype Train hijacking, a therapy session with Dr. Chath derailed by Kendelle's appearance, and a heated Munch & Crum debate on whether aging rappers must legally drop 'Young' from their names — ending with Munch forced to kneel. Rob Elvie was summoned and banned after claiming fictional Alvalstonia citizenship, his voice distorting into Rick on exit. The broadcast closed with Trent's Trailer Time at a movie theater and a raid to Dink Sauce.
